purpose: one independent typed logical-result identity shared by Direct PostgreSQL, Full BDG, Baseline, and Artifact Parquet read-back, with an explicit registered ordering mode

binary_primitives.LP: U64 byte length followed by exactly that many bytes
binary_primitives.domain_rule: domain byte strings below are written raw, including the final NUL byte

schema_encoding.payload: U64(column_count) || for each column in result order: LP(exact column name UTF-8) || LP(canonical SQL type ASCII)
schema_encoding.collation_contract: physical text fields bind en_US.utf8 version 2.36 in benchmark-products-v1; the logical-result order is either a registered query order or canonical typed-row bytes and never an implicit host collation

row_stream_encoding.row: U64(column_count) || for each cell: LP(canonical SQL type) || one byte NULL flag || LP(canonical payload)
row_stream_encoding.value: flag byte 1 followed by LP(canonical payload)
row_stream_encoding.stream: SHA-256(raw domain || for each row in the cell's registered order: LP(encoded row))

ordering_modes.query_order_v1: commit rows exactly in explicit stable-key query order
ordering_modes.canonical_typed_row_lexicographic_v1: sort complete encoded rows by unsigned bytewise lexical order before committing; duplicates are retained; bounded to 200000 rows and 256 MiB encoded bytes

result_encoding.bytes: raw domain || LP(raw 32-byte normalized schema digest) || U64(row_count) || U64(column_count) || LP(raw 32-byte row-stream digest)

canonical_types.name: bigint
canonical_types.payload: exact signed value as 8-byte two's-complement big-endian

canonical_types.name: integer
canonical_types.payload: exact signed value as 4-byte two's-complement big-endian

canonical_types.name: numeric
canonical_types.payload: finite exact decimal UTF-8 expanded without exponent, leading plus, insignificant fractional trailing zeroes, or negative zero; zero is 0

canonical_types.name: text
canonical_types.payload: original valid UTF-8 bytes without normalization, collation folding, trimming, or case folding

canonical_types.name: timestamp without time zone
canonical_types.payload: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS with optional 1-9 fractional digits and no timezone; insignificant fractional trailing zeroes omitted

canonical_types.name: boolean
canonical_types.payload: one byte: 0 for false, 1 for true

total_order_rule: S1, S3, S6, Artifact, and single-Product Scale results use query_order_v1; S2, S4, and S5 use canonical_typed_row_lexicographic_v1 because production Join/semantic-View/UNION grammar forbids ORDER BY

input_adapters.direct: fully drained PostgreSQL typed rows plus field descriptions
input_adapters.bdg: fully drained public BDG typed rows plus field descriptions
input_adapters.artifact: flat non-repeated Parquet columns and rows read from the emitted file using the reviewed logical schema

rejections: unsupported SQL type or PostgreSQL OID
invalid UTF-8 column name/value or duplicate column name
out-of-range integer or inexact floating-point numeric input
row width/type different from normalized schema
partial drain, missing registered ordering mode, or canonical-sort bound exceeded
